# EduPark Blog

> > An educational blog covering science, technology, culture, and practical how-to guides for learners of all ages.

EduPark Blog provides accessible explanations across diverse topics including chemistry (sodium atoms, molecular biology), geometry, physics, software tutorials (Covenant Eyes, networking), cultural guides (Chinese gestures, Spanish LGBTQ+ vocabulary), and reference materials (Texas area codes, stanine scores). Content ranges from beginner-friendly tutorials to in-depth educational articles designed for students, parents, and curious learners.

## Key Topics

- Chemistry & Atomic Structure
- Geometry & 3D Shapes
- Software Uninstallation & Tech Guides
- Molecular Biology & Genetics
- Physics & Everyday Science
- Cultural Practices & Language
- Educational Assessment
- Natural Selection & Evolution
- Networking & Ethernet
- LGBTQ+ Terminology
- Texas Geography
- Records Management
- Environmental Conservation

## Science & Chemistry Education

- [The Core of a Sodium Atom: How Many Protons Does Na Have?](https://edupark.blog/core-sodium-atom-protons-na): Explains sodium atom structure, protons count, and electron configuration
- [How Nonsense Mutations Stop mRNA Translation in Its Tracks](https://edupark.blog/nonsense-mutations-stop-mrna-translation): Explains how nonsense mutations create premature stop codons in mRNA
- [Darwin's Simple Idea That Changed Our View of Life Forever](https://edupark.blog/darwins-simple-idea-changed-view-life): Explains Darwin's natural selection theory from Origin of Species
- [Friction's Hidden Role in How We Walk, Drive & Write](https://edupark.blog/frictions-hidden-role-walk-drive-write): Explores friction physics in everyday activities and movement mechanics

## Technology & Software Guides

- [How to Uninstall Covenant Eyes, With or Without a Code](https://edupark.blog/how-to-uninstall-covenant-eyes): Step-by-step guide for removing Covenant Eyes on Windows, macOS, and iOS
- [Make a Crossover Ethernet Cable for Direct PC-to-PC Links](https://edupark.blog/make-crossover-ethernet-cable-direct-links): DIY guide for creating crossover cables using T568A/B wiring standards

## Mathematics & Geometry

- [The Vertices, Edges, and Faces of a Cone Made Simple](https://edupark.blog/cone-vertices-edges-faces-simple): Breaks down cone geometry and compares 3D shapes like cylinders and spheres
- [Stanine Scores: What the 1-9 Scale Says About Your Child](https://edupark.blog/stanine-scores-1-9-scale): Parent's guide to interpreting stanine scores on standardized tests

## Cultural & Language Guides

- [More Than 'Gay': How to Talk About LGBTQ+ Identity in Spanish](https://edupark.blog/more-than-gay-lgbtq-identity-spanish): LGBTQ+ vocabulary guide in Spanish with formal terms and regional variations
- [What the Pinky Finger Means in China (And Other Gestures)](https://edupark.blog/pinky-finger-meaning-china-gestures): Decodes Chinese hand gestures and cultural differences with Western meanings
- [Praying Istikhara: A Step-by-Step Guide for Clear Decisions](https://edupark.blog/praying-istikhara-guide): Complete tutorial for performing Salat al-Istikhara with dua and translation

## Practical Life & Reference

- [Single-Family Home vs. Townhouse: What Every Buyer Should Know](https://edupark.blog/single-family-home-vs-townhouse): Compares single-family homes, townhouses, and condos for homebuyers
- [All Texas Area Codes: A Simple Lookup Guide by City & Region](https://edupark.blog/texas-area-codes-city-guide): Comprehensive Texas area code directory organized by city and region
- [How Stair Climbing Sculpts Your Glutes, Quads, and Legs](https://edupark.blog/stair-climbing-muscles-worked): Details muscle groups activated during stair climbing including glutes & quads
- [A Record's Life Cycle: Creation to Disposition Explained](https://edupark.blog/record-life-cycle-creation-disposition): Covers records management lifecycle from creation through disposition

## Optional

- [Afforestation vs. Reforestation: Which Is Right for the Land?](https://edupark.blog/afforestation-vs-reforestation-land): Distinguishes afforestation from reforestation with US policy examples
- [How to Conduct a Seance at Home: A Safe Beginner's Guide](https://edupark.blog/how-to-conduct-seance-at-home): Beginner's tutorial on safely conducting a home seance with proper setup
- [How to Play and Win Mille Bornes: Rules and Tips for Beginners](https://edupark.blog/play-win-mille-bornes-rules-tips): Beginner's guide to Mille Bornes card game rules and winning strategies

- [From Barbados to Billboard: Rihanna's Rise to Fame at 17](https://edupark.blog/rihanna-rise-to-fame-17): Chronicles Rihanna's journey from Barbados to stardom with Jay-Z and Def Jam
